detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Digital Deluxe Edition Upgrade unlocks:

  • Cast & Crew Commentary* - Play with unscripted audio commentary from the voice cast or the development team

  • Storyboard Mode - Play the game with the original storyboards

  • The Art of Dispatch: Digital Artbook** - 100+ pages

  • 4 Digital Comics** - 45+ pages

*Commentary audio is English only and is not subtitled

**Only available with English text

Commentary reflects the personal views of the individual speakers and does not necessarily reflect the views of AdHoc Studio. Commentary may reference content that does not appear in the final game.
